title: AI agents and memory costs both reshape how we sell PCs online
summary: Half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI (NRF); Walmart opened Black Friday deals to Meta's AI agent; agents recommend out-of-stock items. HP and Dell expect memory prices to rise through 2027; Adobe sees US Black Friday online sales above $13B.

points.headline: AI agents are becoming a deal-discovery and buying channel
points.detail: NRF finds half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI; Walmart opened Black Friday deals to Meta's agent. Agents also surface out-of-stock items, so our feeds and stock data must be accurate.

points.headline: Memory costs keep PC prices rising into 2027
points.detail: HP and Dell expect memory prices to keep rising in 2027 with a weak PC market; European notebook revenue rose 16% on pricier models. We should plan for price pressure and soft units.

points.headline: AI PC demand is the growth driver as the refresh cycle fades
points.detail: HP says local AI demand is lifting AI PC shipments past expectations while the Windows 11 refresh winds down. We should check our AI PC merchandising online.

points.headline: Holiday online demand is strong, and small businesses are spending
points.detail: Adobe reports online holiday spending up 9.1% and sees Black Friday above $13B; Amex projects a 14-year high in small-business holiday spending. Business bundles and financing are worth pushing.
